arxiv-2012-00922.title: Cross-Modal Terrains: Navigating Sonic Space through Haptic Feedback Conference: NIME’17, May 15-19, 2017, Aalborg University Copenhagen, Denmark.
arxiv-2012-00922.creator: Gabriella Isaac Lauren Hayes Todd Ingalls
arxiv-2012-00922.description: Abstract This paper explores the idea of using virtual textural terrains as a means of generating haptic profiles for force-feedback controllers. This approach breaks from the para-digm established within audio-haptic research over the last few decades where physical models within virtual environments are designed to transduce gesture into sonic output.

arxiv-2104-06740.title: Engineering Predecessor Data Structures for Dynamic Integer Sets
arxiv-2104-06740.creator: Patrick Dinklage, Johannes Fischer, Alexander Herlez
arxiv-2104-06740.description: Abstract We present highly optimized data structures for the dynamic predecessor problem, where the task is to maintain a set S S of w w -bit numbers under insertions, deletions, and predecessor queries (return the largest element in S S no larger than a given key).

arxiv-2105-14838.title: Does the Venue of Scientific Conferences Leverage their Impact? A Large Scale study on Computer Science Conferences
arxiv-2105-14838.creator: Luca Bedogni, Giacomo Cabri, Riccardo Martoglia, Francesco Poggi
arxiv-2105-14838.description: Abstract Background: Conferences bring scientists together and provide one of the most timely means for disseminating new ideas and cutting-edge works. The importance of conferences in scientific areas is testified by quantitative indicators. In Computer Science, for instance, almost two out of three papers published on Scopus are conference papers.

arxiv-2203-16161.title: Recommendation of Compatible Outfits Conditioned on Style Thanks: Supported by Flipkart Internet Pvt. Ltd.
arxiv-2203-16161.creator: Debopriyo Banerjee §, Lucky Dhakad §, Harsh Maheshwari §, Muthusamy Chelliah, Niloy Ganguly, Arnab Bhattacharya
arxiv-2203-16161.description: Abstract Recommendation in the fashion domain has seen a recent surge in research in various areas, for example, shop-the-look, context-aware outfit creation, personalizing outfit creation, etc. The majority of state of the art approaches in the domain of outfit recommendation pursue to improve compatibility among items so as to produce high quality outfits.

arxiv-2208-03814.title: Topological States in Two-Dimensional Su-Schrieffer-Heeger Models
arxiv-2208-03814.creator: Chang-An Li
arxiv-2208-03814.description: Abstract We study the topological properties of the generalized two-dimensional (2D) Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) models. We show that a pair of Dirac points appear in the Brillouin zone (BZ), consisting a semimetallic phase. Interestingly, the locations of these Dirac points are not pinned to any high-symmetry points of the BZ but tunable by model parameters.

arxiv-2304-03855.title: Fluctuating Hydrodynamics and the Rayleigh-Plateau Instability
arxiv-2304-03855.creator: Bryn Barker, John B. Bell, Alejandro L. Garcia
arxiv-2304-03855.description: Abstract The Rayleigh-Plateau instability occurs when surface tension makes a fluid column become unstable to small perturbations. At nanometer scales, thermal fluctuations are comparable to interfacial energy densities. Consequently, at these scales, thermal fluctuations play a significant role in the dynamics of the instability.

arxiv-2305-06318.title: Bridging Borophene and Metal Surfaces: Structural, Electronic, and Electron Transport Properties
arxiv-2305-06318.creator: Wanderlã L. Scopel, F. Crasto de Lima, Pedro H. Souza, José E. Padilha, Roberto H. Miwa
arxiv-2305-06318.description: Abstract Currently, solid interfaces composed of two-dimensional materials (2D) in contact with metal surfaces (m-surf) have been the subject of intense research, where the borophene bilayer (BBL) has been considered a prominent material for the development of electronic devices based on 2D platforms.

arxiv-2308-13829.title: Baikal-GVD Real-Time Data Processing and Follow-Up Analysis of GCN Notices
arxiv-2308-13829.creator: D.Y. Zvezdov
arxiv-2308-13829.description: Abstract The Baikal-GVD alert system was launched at the beginning of 2021. There are alerts for muon neutrinos (long upward-going track-like events) and all-flavour neutrinos (high-energy cascades). The system is able to get a preliminary response to external alerts with a temporal delay of about 3–10 minutes. The Baikal-GVD data processing and the results of the follow-up procedure are described.

arxiv-2312-09892.title: Nonlinear and nonlocal models of heat conduction in continuum thermodynamics Thanks: The research leading to this work has been developed under the auspices of INDAM-GNFM. F.Z. acknowledges also the support of INFN, Gr. IV - Mathematical Methods in NonLinear Physic.
arxiv-2312-09892.creator: Claudio Giorgi, Federico Zullo
arxiv-2312-09892.description: Abstract . The aim of this paper is to develop a general constitutive scheme within continuum thermodynamics to describe the behavior of heat flow in deformable media. Starting from a classical thermodynamic approach, the rate-type constitutive equations are defined in the material (Lagrangian) description where the standard time derivative satisfies the principle of objectivity.

arxiv-2401-02854.title: Exploration of faint X-ray and radio sources in the massive globular cluster M14: A UV-bright counterpart to Nova Ophiuchus 1938 2024 Exploration of faint X-ray and radio sources in the massive globular cluster M14: A UV-bright counterpart to Nova Ophiuchus 1938 – 14
arxiv-2401-02854.creator: Yue Zhao, Francesca D’Antona, Antonino P. Milone, Craig Heinke, Jiaqi Zhao, Phyllis Lugger, Haldan Cohn
arxiv-2401-02854.description: Abstract Using a 12 ks archival Chandra X-ray Observatory ACIS-S observation on the massive globular cluster (GC) M14, we detect a total of 7 7 faint X-ray sources within its half-light radius at a 0.5 − 7 ​ keV 0.5-7\,\mathrm{keV} depth of 2.5 × 10 31 ​ erg ​ s − 1 2.5\times 10^{31}\,\mathrm{erg~s^{-1}} .

arxiv-2401-10347.title: On a Rice theorem for dynamical properties of SFTs on groups
arxiv-2401-10347.creator: Nicanor Carrasco-Vargas
arxiv-2401-10347.description: Abstract Let G G be a group with undecidable domino problem, such as ℤ 2 \mathbb{Z}^{2} . We prove that all nontrivial dynamical properties for sofic G G -subshifts are undecidable, that this is not true for G G -SFTs, and an undecidability result for dynamical properties of G G -SFTs similar to the Adian-Rabin theorem.

arxiv-2501-12982.title: Low-dimensional adaptation of diffusion models: Convergence in total variation
arxiv-2501-12982.creator: Jiadong Liang, Zhihan Huang, Yuxin Chen
arxiv-2501-12982.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Jiadong Liang, Zhihan Huang, Yuxin Chen. This paper investigates how diffusion generative models leverage (unknown) low-dimensional structure to accelerate sampling. Focusing on two mainstream samplers — the denoising diffusion implicit model (DDIM) and the denoising diffusion probabilistic model (DDPM), we prove that their iteration complexities under exact score functions are at most the order of k / ε k/\varepsilon (up to log factor), where ε \varepsilon is the precision in total variation distance and k k is some intrinsic dimension of the target distribution.

arxiv-2505-01252.title: Intrinsic magnetic topological insulators of the MnBi 2 Te 4 family
arxiv-2505-01252.creator: Alexandra Yu. Vyazovskaya, Mihovil Bosnar, Evgueni V. Chulkov, Mikhail M. Otrokov
arxiv-2505-01252.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Alexandra Yu. Vyazovskaya, Mihovil Bosnar, Evgueni V. Chulkov, Mikhail M. Otrokov. This short review appears on the occasion of the fifth anniversary of discovery of intrinsic magnetic topological insulators (MTIs) of the MnBi 2 Te 4 family, which have attracted a great deal of attention recently. This family of materials has been discovered in attempts to increase the observation temperature of the quantum anomalous Hall effect as well as to facilitate the eventual realization of the topological magnetoelectric effect.

arxiv-2511-12329.title: Target Defense against Sequentially Arriving Intruders: Algorithm for Agents with Dubins Dynamics
arxiv-2511-12329.creator: Arman Pourghorban, Dipankar Maity
arxiv-2511-12329.description: Abstract We consider a variant of the target defense problem where a single defender is tasked to capture a sequence of incoming intruders. Both the defender and the intruders have non-holonomic dynamics. The intruders’ objective is to breach the target perimeter without being captured by the defender, while the defender’s goal is to capture as many intruders as possible.

arxiv-2602-05205.title: Aligning Large Language Model Behavior with Human Citation Preferences
arxiv-2602-05205.creator: Kenichiro Ando, Tatsuya Harada
arxiv-2602-05205.description: Abstract Most services built on powerful large-scale language models (LLMs) add citations to their output to enhance credibility. Recent research has paid increasing attention to the question of what reference documents to link to outputs. However, how LLMs recognize cite-worthiness and how this process should be controlled remains underexplored.

britannica-1911-sapan-wood.title: Sapan Wood (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-sapan-wood.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-sapan-wood.description: Article 'Sapan Wood' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 24), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. a tree belonging to the leguminous genus Caesalpinia, a native of tropical Asia and the Indian Archipelago. The wood is somewhat lighter in colour than Brazil wood and its other allies, but the same tinctorial principle, brazilin, appears to be common to all.

europmc-pmc3482661.creator: Suraweera A, Münch C, Hanssum A, Bertolotti A.
europmc-pmc3482661.description: The ubiquitin-proteasome system targets many cellular proteins for degradation and thereby controls most cellular processes. Although it is well established that proteasome inhibition is lethal, the underlying mechanism is unknown. Here, we show that proteasome inhibition...

Esta revisão integrativa comparou a efetividade, a segurança e a durabilidade da escleroterapia...

pmc-10656005.title: KSHV vIL-6 enhances inflammatory responses by epigenetic reprogramming
pmc-10656005.creator: Tomoki Inagaki, Kang-Hsin Wang, Ashish Kumar, Chie Izumiya, Hiroki Miura, Somayeh Komaki, Ryan R. Davis, Clifford G. Tepper, Harutaka Katano, Michiko Shimoda, Yoshihiro Izumiya
pmc-10656005.description: Kaposi sarcoma-associated herpesvirus (KSHV) inflammatory cytokine syndrome (KICS) is a newly described chronic inflammatory disease condition caused by KSHV infection and is characterized by high KSHV viral load and sustained elevations of serum KSHV-encoded IL-6 (vIL-6) and human IL-6 (hIL-6). KICS has significant immortality and greater risks of other complications, including malignancies.

pmc-10671257.title: Blood–Brain Barrier Breakdown in Alzheimer’s Disease: Mechanisms and Targeted Strategies
pmc-10671257.creator: Amer E Alkhalifa, Nour F Al-Ghraiybah, Julia Odum, John G Shunnarah, Nataleigh Austin, Amal Kaddoumi, Agueda A Rostagno, Jorge Ghiso
pmc-10671257.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). The blood–brain barrier (BBB) is a unique and selective feature of the central nervous system’s vasculature. BBB dysfunction has been observed as an early sign of Alzheimer’s Disease (AD) before the onset of dementia or neurodegeneration. The intricate relationship between the BBB and the pathogenesis of AD, especially in the context of neurovascular coupling and the overlap of pathophysiology in neurodegenerative and cerebrovascular diseases, underscores the urgency to understand the BBB’s role more deeply.

pmc-11653555.title: Effects of trehalose on bone healing, physical function, and pain in patients with pertrochanteric fractures: a randomized controlled trial protocol
pmc-11653555.creator: Reza Zandi, Hosna Omidi Razani, Amir Mehrvar, Mohammad-Reza Jowshan, Amirhossein Sahebkar, Bahar Nikooyeh, Hoda Zahedi, Shahin Talebi
pmc-11653555.description: BackgroundAppropriate management of fractures is crucial for restoring natural bone function and preventing long-term complications. Previous research on animal models indicates that trehalose can improve bone fracture healing by inhibiting the inflammatory cascade. We hope that trehalose can accelerate bone fracture healing in humans, alleviate pain, and ultimately enhance the individual’s quality of life.

pmc-12542245.title: Immunization attributable burden of stunting among under-five children in India, 2005–2021
pmc-12542245.creator: Junaid Khan, Sanjay K Mohanty, Parul Puri
pmc-12542245.description: BackgroundThis study examined the stunting differences among Indian children of heterogenous socio-economic characteristics subject to their full immunization (FI) status. It also describes evidence of a declining stunting burden over time among fully immunized children across different socio-economic strata compared to their counter parts.MethodsChildren aged 12–59 months from NFHS, 2005-06 and 2015-16 and 2019-21 constitute the study sample.

pmc-13063471.title: Algal extract as a key protective agent: Jania rubens–enriched PVA/CMC coatings for postharvest onion disease control
pmc-13063471.creator: Doaa E Elsherif, Fatmah A Safhi, Mai A El-Esawy, Nehal E Elkaliny, Noha A El-Sebaii
pmc-13063471.description: BackgroundOnion (Allium cepa L.) is one of the major vegetable crops that are damaged and lost by pathogenic fungal infection during storage due to a lack of proper storage conditions. This study investigates the antifungal potential and mechanism of action of Jania rubens extract against two onion pathogens, Aspergillus niger and Talaromyces calidominioluteus.

pmc-13240841.title: Defibrillation outcomes by pad placement for initially non-shockable out-of-hospital cardiac arrest
pmc-13240841.creator: Amandalin Rock, Matthew R. Neth, Craig D. Newgard, David Dennis, Jack Nuttall, Ritu Sahni, Jonathan Jui, Mohamud R. Daya, Joshua R. Lupton
pmc-13240841.description: Study objectiveOur objective was to determine the association between anterior-posterior (AP) and anterior-lateral (AL) pad placement and outcomes for patients with out-of-hospital cardiac arrest (OHCA) with an initial non-shockable rhythm requiring subsequent defibrillation.MethodsThis observational cohort study included patients with OHCA treated by an emergency medical services (EMS) agency from July 2019 through June 2023.

pmc-13339381.title: In-bore climate control chamber for magnetic resonance imaging of living plants
pmc-13339381.creator: N Knorr, P Rovedo, J Leupold, D von Elverfeldt, L Hesse, S Bär
pmc-13339381.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) enables non-invasive and non-destructive, three-dimensional anatomical and functional imaging of plant tissues and the quantitative investigation of dynamic processes such as water transport. Despite these advantages, MRI remains underutilized in plant and biomimetic research.

pmc-13352001.title: In Vitro Skin-Protective Effects of Sumyong Nature, a Kimchi- and Soybean-Derived Fusion-Fermented Microbial Supernatant, in Human Keratinocytes: Involvement of MAPK-Related Signaling
pmc-13352001.creator: Dilda Kaskadamova, Lei Huang, Nurinanda Prisky Qomaladewi, Natasha Christabella Sutopo, Ji Hye Yoon, Si Eun Yoon, Yerkyesh Khamit, Zhenyan Piao, Chae Kun Lee, Seung Yun Shin, Jae Youl Cho
pmc-13352001.description: Sumyong Nature (SN) is a kimchi- and soybean-derived fusion-fermented microbial supernatant prepared from Lactobacillus acidophilus, Saccharomyces cerevisiae, Weissella cibaria, and Bifidobacterium longum. This study examined the in vitro effects of SN on UVB-induced damage and skin-related cellular responses in human keratinocytes. Cell viability assays, gene expression analysis, luciferase reporter assays, immunoblotting, scratch wound-healing assays, and LC-Q-TOF-MS analysis were conducted.
